blind.description: A stylized, open fantasy treasure chest made of brown wood planks reinforced with gold or brass corner brackets, hinges, and straps. The arched lid is hinged open at the back. Inside, the chest is filled to the brim with a mounded heap of shiny gold coins, embedded with spherical ruby-red and emerald-green gems and a tilted golden goblet. The chest rests on four small rounded feet.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular container divided into the open back lid showing curved wooden planks with brass straps, and the open interior compartment packed with a textured heap of bright yellow gold coins, a few round red and green jewels, and the rim of a gold chalice.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and about 2 feet wide.
